title: flydubai Flight 1073
subtitle: Dubai → Tel Aviv, diverted to Tabuk
note: A reconstruction from the aircraft's own ADS-B broadcasts of a serious incident in which everyone aboard landed safely. Nine minutes of the dive were not received and are reconstructed; what happened in the cockpit has not been officially established.
summary: flydubai 1073, a Boeing 737 MAX 8, from Dubai to Tel Aviv on 30 September 2026.

Over northern Saudi Arabia the aircraft left 34,000 ft without a descent selected and dived steeply. It declared an emergency (7700), then set 7500 (unlawful interference), turned back over Jordan and landed at Tabuk.
Israeli security officials attributed the emergency to a confrontation between the two pilots. The cause is under investigation.

card.title: flydubai Flight 1073
lines: 30 September 2026 · Boeing 737 MAX 8 A6-FKF, Dubai to Tel Aviv.
After the open networks lost it, the aircraft continued at low level over Saudi Arabia and landed at Tabuk. flydubai said all passengers were safe.
Israeli security officials said the emergency stemmed from a confrontation between the two pilots. Its cause, and whether the dive was deliberate, have not been officially established.
Reconstruction from the aircraft's ADS-B broadcasts as received by adsb.lol (ODbL), checked against ADS-B Exchange, theairtraffic and OpenSky. 05:22:13–05:31:26 was not received and is reconstructed.
